scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.deploy:firebase: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/task-manager run build && corepack pnpm exec firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.render-build: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/task-manager run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
